readingAids.title: Reading aids
readingAids.nikud.note: For reading only: the note and the file stay exactly as written. Niqqud is added on this device by the Nakdimon model, which asks before it downloads.
readingAids.font.openDyslexic: OpenDyslexic for Latin text, Noto Sans Hebrew for Hebrew
readingAids.lineFocus: Highlight the line or paragraph I'm reading
readingAids.read.note: "Read aloud" in the palette reads the note with this device's voices and highlights each word as it is spoken (when the voice reports words).
